def is_nested(string):
    open_brackets = []
    nested = False
    
    for bracket in string:
        if bracket == '[':
            open_brackets.append(bracket)
        elif bracket == ']':
            if not open_brackets:
                return False  # Unmatched closing bracket
            open_brackets.pop()
            
            # Check if there's a possibility of nesting
            if len(open_brackets) > 1 or nested:
                nested = True
    
    return nested and not open_brackets

# Test cases
print(is_nested('[[]]'))       # ➞ True
print(is_nested('[]]]]]]][[[[[]'))   # ➞ False
print(is_nested('[][]'))      # ➞ False
print(is_nested('[]'))        # ➞ False
print(is_nested('[[][]]'))    # ➞ True
print(is_nested('[[]][['))    # ➞ True

CONFIDENCE: 95
